title: Existence thresholds and limit profiles of ground states for lower critical Choquard equations with general nonlinearities
summary: In this paper, we study the existence, non-existence and asymptotic behavior of positive ground states for the nonlinear Choquard equation: \begin{equation}\label{0.1} -Δu+\varepsilon u=\big(I_α\ast F(u)\big)F'(u),\quad u\in H^1(\mathbb R^N), \end{equation} where $F(u)=|u|^{\frac{N+α}{N}}+G(u)$ with $G(u)=\int_0^ug(s)ds$, $N\geq3$ is an integer, $I_α$ is the Riesz potential of order $α\in(0,N)$ and $\varepsilon>0$ is a frequency parameter.
